title: Constant time testability of first-order logic with modulo counting on finitary graphs
summary: This paper studies algorithmic meta theorems for property testing with \emph{constant running time} in the bounded degree model. In (Adler, Harwath 2018) it was shown that on graph classes $\mathcal C^{w}_d$ consisting of all graphs with both degree at most $d$ and treewidth at most $w$, every problem expressible in monadic second-order logic with counting (CMSO) is testable with \emph{polylogarithmic} running time (where $d,w\in \mathbb N$ are fixed). It was left open whether this can be improved to \emph{constant} running time. In this paper we give a positive answer for testing CMSO on…
